// divguard:path coding/session.go

package coding

type Session struct {
	events    chan int
	listeners []func(int)
}

// forwardAgentEvents reproduces AGENT-16: a panicking listener silently
// ends forwarding, and the next run blocks on a full channel.
func (s *Session) forwardAgentEvents() {
	defer func() {
		_ = recover() // want
		close(s.events)
	}()
	for ev := range s.events {
		for _, l := range s.listeners {
			l(ev)
		}
	}
}

func (s *Session) emit(ev int) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil { // want
			return
		}
	}()
	defer recover() // want
	for _, l := range s.listeners {
		l(ev)
	}
}

func (s *Session) guard(fn func()) (failed bool) {
	defer func() { failed = recover() != nil }() // want
	fn()
	return false
}

// swallow assigns the panic value to an outer variable, then only tests it
// against nil: the value is still thrown away.
func (s *Session) swallow(fn func()) bool {
	var failure any
	func() {
		defer func() { failure = recover() }() // want
		fn()
	}()
	return failure == nil
}
